Alex Chen: Quick triage — I ran a sweep of audit coverage and found missing signals across API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Can we pull owners and assign remediation priorities?
Maria Gomez: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the short list of missing events?
Alex Chen: sure — top items: 1) API gateway: missing inbound request authorization failures (401/403) with user_id + client_ip 2) Auth: RBAC change events missing role_old/role_new in the audit schema 3) Console: admin UI export actions not logged (export_user_data/export_account) 4) Billing: invoice-download events missing invoice_id and request_origin 5) Runtime: model fallback & replica switch events not emitted.
Devin Patel: ok noted. are there existing tickets?
Alex Chen: I created SEC-721 for gateway auth failures, SEC-722 for auth schema RBAC, ENG-1314 for console exports, BILL-58 for billing downloads, RUNTIME-99 for model fallback. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-721 (mock link)
Samira Rao: tagging owners — @maria for gateway, @devin for auth & RBAC schema, @samira for runtime.
Maria Gomez: I can pick gateway. Quick Q: do we need to include policy_id or full policy blob on RBAC changes?
Devin Patel: prefer policy_id + diff (role_old, role_new). full blob is noisy for customers; we can surface blob via internal trace only.
Samira Rao: runtime fallback needs correlation id with request_id + model_variant. Without that customers can't map to traces.
Alex Chen: agree. Also KMS question: for billing/export evidence we need signed audit proofs for some customers — can ops sign them with KMS?
Ops Bot: ops-bot: Customer-signed evidence flow exists. KMS integration planned in PRIV-2. For now we can attach HMAC token generated by audit service.
Maria Gomez: timeline? Gateway changes look small (middleware hook) — I can do a PR this week. Will add tests that validate schema fields.
Devin Patel: RBAC schema change needs backward-compatible migration. plan: emit both old_event_type and new_event_type for 4 weeks, then flip. I'll draft migration doc: /docs/internal/audit-rbac-migration.md
Alex Chen: good. Can we add automated customer-facing validation? e.g., run sample export and assert required fields are present and signed (for customers with evidence flag).
Samira Rao: I'll add an e2e smoke in our test harness that exercises export + billing download + runtime fallback. Add ticket QA-204.
Alex Chen: Action items summary: Maria -> SEC-721 gateway logs (ETA 3d). Devin -> SEC-722 RBAC schema + migration plan (ETA 1wk). Samira -> RUNTIME-99 add correlation + e2e tests (ETA 1wk). Alex -> coordinate KMS/evidence approach with ops + open PRIV-2 followup. Owners add test vectors to ticket.
Maria Gomez: noted. Adding labels: audit, high-priority, customer-impact.
Devin Patel: will prototype schema in a branch and ping for review.
Samira Rao: thanks — we should call this out in next week's compliance retro.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone :white_check_mark: If no objections I'll move tickets to triage and set target sprint.
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup:
Devin Patel: +1
Samira Rao: no objections
Ops Bot: ops-bot: Logged follow-up PRIV-2 and attached KMS design notes.
Alex Chen: closing thread — ping me on PRs or drop updates here for quick sync.
